items.title: Mature Monstera Leaf
items.alt: One complete broad heart-shaped mature monstera leaf with natural deep edge splits and several enclosed internal perforations on either side of the central midrib, glossy emerald green, full petiole.

items.title: Banana Leaf
items.alt: One complete long broad banana leaf with a strong central midrib, fine parallel lateral veins and just two small natural edge tears, gently arched blade and full short stalk.
